kpis.name: notebooks_passing

source.cmd: python3 qa_check.py 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json, sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(sum(1 for c in d['checks'] if c['ok']))"

kpis.description: Number of notebooks that executed cleanly in the most recent run

kpis.name: notebooks_failing

source.cmd: python3 qa_check.py 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json, sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(sum(1 for c in d['checks'] if not c['ok']))"

kpis.description: Number of notebooks that errored during execution
